merge_basis: Candidate T0017 concerns Zongertinib in adjuvant NSCLC (Beamion LUNG-3, study 1479-0032), which is a distinct indication and study from all existing groups: G0005 covers 1L NSCLC NDA approval, G0011 covers a China-alone IIS in NSCLC, and G0012/G0015 cover breast cancer and gastric cancer Phase 3 trials respectively. Different study number and indication (adjuvant vs. 1L) preclude merging.
